name: org.iqnect.iqkit.ui.coupons.CouponListActivity
description: The iQNECT iQKIT SDK opens its wallet screen to show saved coupons. The screen can load, add, or remove coupons from the user's wallet.
disableEffect: If disabled, the app's iQNECT coupon wallet and its add or remove flow are unavailable.
